description: Get a company's share-repurchase (buyback) picture: tracked programs (announcement date, authorized total in money or shares, remaining availability, expiry, source filings), the latest authorization figures, and repurchase history: cash spent, shares repurchased and average price per fiscal year and recent quarters. Figures come from the company's XBRL facts plus verified extractions of its filings' narrative text and its press releases, including a Canadian normal course issuer bid's maximum number of shares; nothing is estimated, and figures a company stopped restating carry a staleness label. For a B3 listing (BVMF:TICKER) it also lists every board-approved program, newest first: approval and end dates, status, the most shares it may buy of each kind and class against that class's free float, whether bought shares are cancelled or kept in treasury, and the company's treasury shares. For at-the-market (ATM) equity offering programs, the dilution mirror image, see GetAtmPrograms.

ticker.description: Stock ticker symbol (e.g., AAPL, MSFT), or MIC:TICKER (e.g., XTSE:WDO, BVMF:VALE3) for a listing outside the US.
